name: GDPR Consent Management Platform
author: ShareThis

sections.description:
GDPR Consent Management Platform (CMP) by ShareThis is a free, IAB Europe registered (ID #25) consent solution for WordPress websites. Fully compliant with the IAB Transparency & Consent Framework (TCF) v2.3, the plugin helps publishers manage user consent while meeting modern European privacy requirements.

Built for simplicity, scalability, and performance, the ShareThis CMP integrates seamlessly into WordPress without adding unnecessary complexity or overhead.

Key Features

  • Completely Free
    Use the plugin at no cost with no premium upgrades, hidden fees, pageview restrictions, or traffic caps. Install it on unlimited domains and subdomains.

  • IAB TCF v2.3 Compliant
    Support the latest IAB Transparency & Consent Framework standards and communicate consent preferences to thousands of registered advertising and technology vendors.

  • Official IAB Europe Registered CMP
    ShareThis is an officially registered Consent Management Platform with IAB Europe (CMP ID #25), ensuring broad ecosystem compatibility.

  • Unlimited Traffic Support
    Built to scale with websites of all sizes, from small blogs to high traffic publishers.

  • Customizable Appearance
    Configure banner colors directly from the WordPress admin area, including accent colors, background colors, text colors, and privacy icon styling to match your brand identity.

  • Purpose Selection Controls
    Select the specific IAB consent purposes relevant to your website and business model, including options such as:

    • Store and/or access information on a device
    • Personalized advertising
    • Content measurement
    • Audience insights

  • Vendor Management
    Search the global IAB vendor list and exclude specific third-party vendors from receiving consent on your website.

  • Geo-Aware Display Options
    Display the GDPR consent banner only to visitors in the European Union or globally across all traffic for a consistent compliance experience.

  • Privacy Policy Integration
    Add your privacy policy URL directly inside the consent dialog for increased transparency and accessibility.

  • Lightweight Performance
    The consent banner is delivered through the ShareThis edge platform with no additional database tables, theme bloat, or unnecessary infrastructure requirements.

  • Optimized for ShareThis Plugins
    If you already use ShareThis tools such as Share Buttons, the CMP integrates directly into the existing ShareThis admin menu for a cleaner dashboard experience.

Important Note

This plugin is specifically designed for GDPR and IAB TCF v2.3 compliance. It does not currently support US privacy frameworks such as CCPA or CPRA, or other non-EU regional privacy regulations.

Why You Need a CMP

Under GDPR, ePrivacy, and similar regulations, publishers must obtain informed, recorded consent before loading non-essential cookies, trackers, or advertising vendors. A Consent Management Platform (CMP) is the tool that requests that consent, stores the user’s choices, and broadcasts them to your downstream partners in a standard, machine-readable format. Without one, ad and analytics revenue from EU users is legally at risk.

Privacy

By installing and using the Consent Management Platform by ShareThis you agree to our terms of use. Those terms include ShareThis’s ability to record interactions with the consent banner. Read the full privacy policy at https://www.sharethis.com/privacy/.
sections.installation:
1. From your WordPress admin, go to Plugins > Add New, search for Consent Management Platform, and click Install Now, then Activate. (Or upload the plugin ZIP directly via Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.)
  2. Open the new Consent Management Platform menu in the WordPress sidebar. If you already have the ShareThis Share Buttons plugin installed, the settings live under the existing ShareThis menu instead.
  3. Configure the banner — set your publisher name, privacy policy URL, display region, colors, purposes, and any vendor exclusions.
  4. Click Update to publish the configuration. The consent banner will appear on your site within a few minutes.
sections.faq:
What is GDPR?

GDPR (General Data Protection Regulation) is a European regulation that gives EU citizens and residents greater control over their personal data and standardizes data-handling rules for any business that touches EU users.

Who has to comply with GDPR?

Any company established in the EU, plus any company anywhere in the world that processes personal data of EU residents.

What counts as “personal data”?

Any information that can directly or indirectly identify an individual. The data ShareThis collects through this plugin is limited to identifiers such as cookies and IP addresses — not emails, postal addresses, phone numbers, or national IDs.

What is a CMP?

A Consent Management Platform collects and stores user consent and communicates that consent status to the vendors operating on your site. It is configurable by the publisher and editable by the visitor at any time.

Is this plugin IAB-compliant?

Yes. The Consent Management Platform by ShareThis is built on the IAB Transparency & Consent Framework (TCF) v2.

Does the plugin keep the vendor list up to date?

Yes. The plugin loads the current IAB Global Vendor List directly from ShareThis at runtime, so additions, removals, and policy URL changes appear without a plugin update.

How long is personal data retained?

ShareThis retains usage data for up to 14 months from the date of collection. Cookies expire 13 months after they are last updated.

How do users opt out or request deletion?

Visitors can withdraw consent through the banner at any time, or contact privacy@sharethis.com. The full opt-out procedure is documented on the ShareThis privacy page.

Does installing this plugin make my site fully GDPR compliant?

This plugin gives you a fully functional, IAB-compliant consent mechanism — a required building block. Full GDPR compliance also depends on your privacy policy, internal data-handling practices, and any other vendors on your site. Please consult legal counsel for advice specific to your business.

How do I preview the banner from outside the EU?

Use any reputable VPN service to browse your site from an EU IP address. The banner will appear if your display setting is EU only.

Is the plugin compatible with the Google Analytics Dashboard plugin?

No. The Google Analytics Dashboard plugin is known to conflict with this CMP. The settings screen will warn you if both are active.
